messages:
eli_sre: quick q — incident ops needs an ad-hoc export of auth events (logins/fails) for an external auditor. what's the approved flow? need PII redaction and who is allowed to trigger it. pinging @sec_ops
sec_ops: for audit requests we use the audit-export-service. you must open an access-request workflow (https://redwood.app/workflows/access-requests) and get sec + legal signoff. export tool supports --redact and schema versioning.
eli_sre: thanks. is the --redact mode deterministic? auditor needs stable pseudonyms (countable metrics) but emails/SSNs removed.
ben_infra: export service redacts email/ssn by default. for stable ids you can map user_id -> hashed_uid with the map flag. example command:```
audit-export \n  --service=auth \n  --since=2025-11-01 \n  --format=parquet \n  --redact=PII \n  --map=user_id:hashed_uid \n  --out=s3://redwood-exports/incident-2025-11-12/
```
anya_sre: quick ops note — exports created this way follow the export-retention policy (90 days default). if auditor needs longer retention, push to an approved external bucket and get legal signoff.
kate_legal: we can approve extended retention for formal audits if you attach the signed LOA to the access request. prefer parquet over csv to preserve schema and redaction provenance.
eli_sre: ok i'll open the access-request and attach the LOA. who actually runs the export after approvals? do we need infra/sec to execute it?
sec_ops: infra will run exports that transfer data outside our org. if the export stays in our org's S3 we allow self-serve after approvals. we'll coordinate with @ben_infra for outbound exports.
export_bot: export job submitted by ben_infra at 1759003450; estimated size 1.2GB; path s3://redwood-exports/incident-2025-11-12/; logs: https://redwood.app/exports/1759003450
eli_sre: :thumbsup: closing the loop — i'll update incident ticket INST-412 and mark the access-request done once signed. thanks everyone!
